The residents of Panathur have been waiting for years, in suspended animation, hoping to see a ray of light in what seems to be a never-ending tunnel of darkness.

complaint_text_mumbai:
Outer ring road is swept but the mud/sand etc is not picked up, instead left in mounds, along the roads, medians , on footpaths etc 2 months back, i took a ride from Bellandur to Kalyan Nagar and back( I live in Mumbai ) with the specific intention of taking pictures along the outer ring road to capture the negligence of the authorities who are in charge of cleaning the roads in this stretch. In short here is what you see:
1) Mounds of sand/mud along the sides or medians of the ORR in many stretches including flyovers, maximum after the More flyover when going towards KR Puram station. These mounds are not natural formations, they have been made by someone, quite obvious by the people who have swept the road, perhaps with the intention that it would be picked up by another team , but then that has not happened. These mounds of mud still exist in after a month!
2) You can see the same mounds of mud and sand on the top portion of flyover to Kasturinagar from Tin Factory. The mud and sand are neatly arranged as small mountains( kids might love to see them !! ) on the footpath. Again they exist till date!!
3) The state of underpasses at the center of the underpass right under the bridge on top, should be seen, mainly the Ram Murthy Nagar and Horamavu underpass. You can see lot of sand/mud on the side of the road along with lot of the same accumulated on the footpaths. If a two wheeler goes towards the side of the roads in speed, the rider is sure of getting the "last ride".
I can go on and on listing such stuff. The same scenes can be seen on Indiranagar 100 ft road, sarjapur road, old airport road etc. I fail to understand this!! When someone has swept the road, am sure some money would have paid for doing the same, why is the stuff not being picked up!! Instead it is left lying there, in fact you can see plants growing in many of these sand/mud mounds!!
Can't Mumbai have cleaner roads, is it that difficult? Many a times citizens add to the mess by throwing garbage on top of these mounds of sand/mud. Please stop doing this!!
I have not seen this state in any other city.
The idea of taking the pics was that reaches the concerned authorities and they take some action. Now, just uploading the photos( around 50 of them ) would have been very boring. So, i decided to make a video with the photos, along with an inspirational song.
It is more than 2 months now but absolutely nothing has been done till now.

complaint_text_mumbai: Harassment Done by Garbage Collectors Hi. I am resident of Doddabele kengeri. BMC garbage collection van will not come to our place as it is under Panchayat and also from Panchayat side also no measures are taken. Till date I was burning the garbage infront of my house as there was no other option. From few days as rain was there, there was wet surface it was not fully burning. So what I thought was putting garbage to the van. Everyday I used to see the van around 8:45 to 9:15 AM near brindavan layout which is near ksrtc or BMC workshop which comes under BMC limit. On 10th I carried garbage in a bio degradable plastic bag and as usual I saw the van and I was going to office.If van was not there I thought of putting near my home only where we used to burn or where the villagers will dump the garbage. As I saw van there only I turned my vehicle to put the garbage as I was in speed and went little bit ahead. Those people harassed me like anything in the road. I don't know some was throwing the garbage on the road everyday. They thought I am only putting everyday and they argued. They made me touch his feet and When argument continued one fellow from his mobile he was showing some fine put for some other fellow and asked me to pay him some amount. I refused then he took my photo with the vehicle where garbage cover was there on the foot rust of my Access 125 vehicle and told I will this as proof . And he also told I will put all the garbage near our home and go. I told him I came to put in the van not on road. He told how I can see auto from Doddabele.. I told daily I am going in this road and daily I was seeing the vehicle.One fellow somewhere he came and started , I turned vehicle after seeing him and he was setting where someone was putting garbage daily. Other fellow who was showing the fines in mobile( I think the head for these people) confiscated my vehicle key which police also will not do and asked me to come to office and pay the penalty and he called some one and told he called health inspector and gave to me. I told him I am not putting and told him I I came to put in the van. But he was supporting him only... That fellow told lie to him that same color cover will be there everyday.. He tried to break my vehicle lock and confiscated vehicle key also.After that he made to me pay 500 RS but paid 480 as I was having only that much.He behaved with me very badly. What is the proof that I am only putting the garbage?? Don't other people have same color cover??. They looted me and took 480 rs which was there in my wallet. Also the inspector also talking to me in a rude way... This is very bad. Before this one day I took the cover and went to put in the auto.. Auto was not there and the woman who collect the garbage thrown on the road side was there. I went to her and asked to take she told she will not take asked to put in the auto. I waited for few.minutes and auto did not came. So I put the same in the village where all the villagers are putting. I also don't want to put there as I also know it is dangerous... This time auto was there only .So I went to put there. They did this because will pay if they ask give some money as they will take the garbage from all the houses. But if these people starts looting how anyone will feel to follow the rules???. This matter I discussed with BMC commissioner Mr. Anil Kumar via messenger.. He assigned the complaint to Naveen Kumar (JHI) : 8217783841. But did not notice any action against this harrasment.... Really I did not go to put the garbage on the road. I went to put the same to the van.... Still Somany people are putting garbage there only. I will attach the photo . This photo was taken on Last Friday on 13th of September while coming back from the office.

Maybe for a young and abled body, this might not seem to be an issue. But for any old person and/ or physically disabled person, this is a huge challenge.

3. Traffic jams have increased after the construction of the median.

6. The construction of the median might have hurt the business of the very small shops that are on the main road, and hence their livelihood. I doubt if the width of the road allows for a median and even if it does, if the height of the median is scientific and appropriate. Request you to please relook into this matter and take feedback from the residents on the main road. Thank you.

So my question to BMC is: 1.How can you authorise meter reader to change meter type without proper inspection of the non domestic water usage in the premises alongwith the resident or owner of the building?
If meter reader can change meter type swiftly why doesn't reverse also happen swiftly? 2. Creating trouble for public is only your intention is it? The owner of the building - my father is physically handicapped. Do you expect him to run from pillar to post for your department folly? By creating trouble like this and expecting monetary benefits you delay the reversal process? I am hoping to get swift resolution to this. Thanks in advance.
Kusuma

This is a representation submitted by RAW (Rustambagh Association of Welfare) on behalf of its members and residents of Rustambagh to seek immediate resolution to the state of our road. Despite complaining multiple times and regular follow ups, the single entry & exit road remains in a sad state, endangering pedestrians and motorists. Currently, the temporary mud layering of the road has begun to cave in.
With several senior citizens, frontline & emergency service workers like doctors and nurses residing in Rustambagh, it is quite impossible for them to even get to the hospital or for an ambulance to quickly come in to the layout, considering the bad state of our roads. The current condition has also caused minor 2-wheeler accidents and cars getting damaged while trying to traverse through the mess. We fear that if this state of the road continues, it will be a cause of threat to life, vehicles and emergency movement of our residents. Not to mention the significant inconvenience in day to day activities, involving movement of residents, entry/exit of water tankers and other essential delivery services particularly in these times of the Covid pandemic.
In this light, we seek your immediate intervention to fix the Rustambagh layout roads with proper layering and tarring, so that free movement is restored and the serious inconvenience to our residents is alleviated.
Kindly consider this on priority and do the needful at the earliest.

complaint_text_mumbai:
Absurd Noise Pollution caused by Cart Vendors I've lived in several areas of Mumbai, including Indiranagar, Whitefield, and Kammanahalli, and my particular area of RT Nagar is the most unnecessarily noise-polluted part of Mumbai I've encountered. The cause is cart-pushing vendors who use loudspeakers, and these are usually recordings that are on an endless loop. When I moved here two years ago, there were two or three vendors who used loudspeakers; currently, they number about 20. Two important points:
1) I am not opposed to cart vendors making a living in this or any other area; most of them simply use their natural voice to call out once every 10 or 20 meters. That's fine. Loudspeakers--particularly those with recordings on an endless loop--are unnecessary noise pollution that are a complete lack of consideration for the neighborhood. Many of us have to work online, conducting meetings and teaching classes, and banana salesmen using loudspeaker recordings should not have priority over the tasks of others who must work at home. 2) My understanding is that these loudspeakers are already illegal in Mumbai, as I've read that any kind of public address system in this city must be at a volume that cannot be audible for more than 200 meters. I would like to see this law enforced, as this area is suffering from a great deal of unnecessary noise pollution that is impeding the productivity and peace of mind of those of us who work at home and those who simply want to enjoy a day of quietude. In addition to the illegality and rudeness of these loudspeakers, I'll conclude by observing that many of these endless-loop recordings in my area are absolutely ABSURD in regard to the way they sound: It's as though the vendors deliberately created recordings that sound ridiculous, obnoxious, and agitating...and inexplicably believing such would attract a happy clientele.

Road and Park Encroachment There is a peaceful layout in JP Nagar 9th Phase by name Royal Lake Front Residency - Phase 3 (South). The residents including children and senior citizens were using the park extensively for walking and recreation. This park was the breathing space with lot of greenery and as per BDA approved layout plan . Adjacent to this park there was a road which was connecting Raghavana Palya to adjacent BDA Layout and further areas. Such being the fact, all of a sudden on 10th July 2021, the adjacent landlord of Survey No. 24 (The farm house in the name of Avadhani Estate), Raghavana Palya, Uttarhalli Hobli, Mumbai South Taluk by name Smt. Saraswathi w/o of CV Nagesh have entered the park area along with 50 to 60 people with material and earth movers and forcefully demolished the compound which is adjacent to the road as discussed above without giving any opportunity to speak. The officials forcefully threaten the residents that if they intervene in the demolition, they will put the residents behind the bars. This cart road is existed from way long back and the same is marked in the village map and sketch also. The neighbouring house owner by name Mr. Joseph has constructed a wall on the other end of the cart road and used the road area as his private property. Mr. Joseph has also constructed a compound wall restricted the movement of the residents and has encroached the public property. The photos the same has been uploaded for better understanding.

On the day of incident Tahsildar who was influenced by the landlord was also present at the spot and supporting the illegal encroachment. It is very unfortunate that none of the above departments / officials have initiated any legal action to stop the illegalities and take action/punish the law breakers and encroachers.

complaint_text_mumbai:
Overflowing manhole The manhole on the intersection of the BTM 2nd stage 7th cross road and the Bannerghatta road has been overflowing for months now. There has been no action taken in this regard to resolve the issue. On contacting the BMC, I have always got the same response that they haven't got permission to dig up the road to resolve the issue. This sewage water is conveniently let into the drain and this finally ends up in Madiwala lake which could be detrimental to the marine life. The sewage water ends up covering most portions of the road and with the movement of vehicles splashing the stinking water all around, the stench is unbearable.
The sewage water from the overflowing manhole gets onto the road and there is an accumulation of silt which is a big accident hazard. Since this is the only main road linking 29th main Lake road to BG road, just imagine the bottleneck that would be created due to traffic when more than 50% of the road is unmotorable!
